cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in a Command ('Command Injection')

exact_cwe_mechanism.evidence: The code constructs a shell command by directly interpolating user-controlled remoteUrl into a git clone command executed via child_process.exec(), which is the exact mechanism described by CWE-77

connection.evidence: remoteUrl is either direct user input parameter or output from createCustomRemote(); when createCustomDiff=false, remoteUrl flows directly from user input to shell command execution without validation

diff_causality.evidence: This line is newly added (change_type: 'A') and directly introduces the vulnerable command construction pattern where remoteUrl is interpolated into shell command

security_control.evidence: No validation, sanitization, or parameterization of remoteUrl before shell interpolation
security_control.control_requirement_evidence: CWE-77 requires neutralizing special shell characters in command arguments to prevent injection
existing_controls_checked: No input validation on remoteUrl parameter
Direct string interpolation into shell command
security_control.deficiency_evidence: The code uses template literal interpolation without any sanitization, allowing shell metacharacters in remoteUrl to modify command execution

concrete_impact.evidence: Command injection could lead to arbitrary command execution with the privileges of the application process

diff_counterfactual: If the candidate line were reverted, the vulnerable command interpolation pattern would not exist in the codebase, preventing the command injection vulnerability.
supporting_evidence: remoteUrl is either direct user input parameter or generated by createCustomRemote() function
The code uses template literal interpolation: `git clone ${remoteUrl} ${_tmpDir}`
utils.run() executes via child_process.exec() which uses shell interpretation
No validation or sanitization of remoteUrl before command construction
contradicting_evidence: When createCustomDiff=true, remoteUrl comes from createCustomRemote() which may generate safe temporary paths
unresolved_facts: Whether createCustomDiff parameter has secure default value
Validation applied to remoteUrl when passed as direct parameter
Security controls in createCustomRemote's command execution
review_comment: The code directly interpolates user-controlled remoteUrl into a shell command without validation or parameterization, creating a command injection vulnerability. When createCustomDiff is false, remoteUrl flows from direct user input to git clone execution. Use parameterized command execution by passing remoteUrl and _tmpDir as separate arguments to avoid shell interpolation.
